_note: The board (docs/design/v2-board.md), route #/bwrdd. Owner: package 10. Plain words (docs/design/plain-wales.md): reading age 11, no sentence over 18 words, coins not pounds, Why? not threads. Full i18n key is board.<key>. Engine Say keys are the same full keys. Plurals use .one and .other with {n}. Names of projects, events (as titles), endings, chapters and places live in model/board/*.yaml as {en, cy} text, not here. No figure appears here: numbers come in through slots from the model, with their labels. The screens' own words are in boardui.json. event.<id> is each event's name as a noun phrase for the middle of a sentence ("a dirty river"); the engine sends it as a key in an {event} slot.
